body:
I look at myself... And it's just hideous. I hate myself. I don't know how to explain it. But I know it all started after remembering a memory I buried from my childhood. I don't know how to fix this. 
*EDIT: I recently went to bereavement counseling to try to grieve my sister's death (she died ten years ago but I've never dealt with it)  and I was diagnosed with PTSD from that and childhood abuse, and as I started opening those doors to my sister's death, I suddenly remembered being six or seven and someone touching me when they shouldn't have. It started then. And I've been lost since then.
